posts.name: Paptimus
posts.cooked:
Some remarks for the wiki:

-K.N.Y.F.E.'s incapacitated art seems to be a reference to X-Men (2nd run) #25, by Scott Lobdell and Andy Kubert, when Magneto removes the adamantium from Wolverine's skeleton. Since Citizen Dawn is Sentinels Comics' Magneto...

-Am I the only one who sees the Sentinels as a mix between the Fantastic Four and the original Doom Patrol (rather than the Avengers, as stated on the wiki)? The family pattern was found in the Doom Patrol too (Beast-Boy being adopted by Mento and Elasti-Girl), and the Patrol was much more of a band of misfits that the FF (which seems to fit with Writhe, who also looks a bit like Negative-Man, or with the Idealist's somehow disturbing origin)...

Who knows, for what we know, Caleb could be a Chief-like bearded man in a wheelchair mentoring the team... 

Or he could be some technical genius, about to invent some gadget which will allow him to join the team (like Mento)... In Tactics timeline!
